verdict.rationale: Close documents an official MCP server with write scopes (mcp.write_safe) usable from Claude and ChatGPT, plus a REST API where opportunities have a customizable status (deal stage). PUT behaves as a patch for targeted field updates, and opportunities carry note/note_html fields that could hold next steps. Webhooks and the Event Log let an agent pick up email and activity signals to act on. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a dedicated next-step field, no documented meeting-signal ingestion via API/MCP, no worked example of an agent updating stages from email or meeting data, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
